actual_adapters: Shared Fixture owns charged aligned placement storage and the actual runtime/native memory owner, actual Environment Paths/Map, actual EnabledDebugList and Permission debug callbacks. The selected trace callback is an explicitly named delegation observer only.

Permission controls never Parse Debug: their list is genuinely initially disabled. No fake disabled callback is supplied. Debug15 uses actual live parsing and real Permission Insert output under a synchronous stderr capture.
C++ formatter test adapter invokes only the two actual Permission SPrintF instantiations, then visits the real native result String while it remains owned. FWrite is the production function.

FILE observers use actual tmpfile, flush/seek/read and a temporary descriptor redirect. Windows binary CRT mode is explicit fixture input. They restore the prior stderr descriptor/mode before assertion inspection and do not qualify WriteConsoleW.

The UV adapter uses real uv_replace_allocator, which the retained original source shows installs the provided callbacks directly. Each wrapper calls actual original malloc/realloc/calloc/free and tracks real pointers in a fixed native array. It wraps only one synchronous actual Permission directory Apply after stat+cleanup warmup; no asynchronous libuv work or surviving UV object is admitted.

Both directory cleanup controls read live-block and byte counts captured BEFORE emergency observer cleanup. On Windows they also require actual allocations and a nonzero peak, so the original missing request cleanup causes a nonzero observed leak even though the adapter later retires that dead stack-request allocation.

Permission14/18 exercise actual nonterminal wildcard descendants and ordinary children, then destroy the genuine Permission and assert the exact native allocation baseline. The previously approved recursion correction is required for these assertions.

Native retry controls reuse the previously closed actual std::new_handler adapter and shared one-TLS allocation domain. No allocation or error result is mocked. Existing JS OOM occurrence and pending reasons are observed independently.

Native raw operations under limit1 retain exact ordinary/generic reasons or the actual private termination generation. Fixture disables private termination only during final VM cleanup. All raw reason values are owned before assertions.

Permission17 explicitly retires the VM, other Environment leaves and caller entitlement before exercising retained Permission flags and its concrete derived shared_ptr destruction. Debug19 formats after VM/caller retirement using the genuine remaining native owner.
